result.delta_convention: scenario minus current; ratio deltas are absolute ratio changes, not relative percentage changes
result.numeric_serialization: Decimal strings rounded to 28 significant digits; arithmetic is exact rational. UI values are formatted separately.
limitations: Monthly simplified model: no dated payment calendar, instalment schedule, fees, interest accrual or changes in contract balances are modeled.
Savings S is held fixed across scenarios; the model does not simulate repeated monthly depletion.
Income shocks and BNPL reductions are user assumptions, not forecasts or regulatory thresholds.
No model score, survey code, credit decision, safe borrowing limit or default probability is calculated.

scenarios.title: Current
assumptions: All amounts use one currency and a monthly time unit; no foreign-exchange conversion is performed.
Income is monthly after-tax income. E excludes every repayment already counted in D, B0 or Bnew.
D contains non-BNPL repayments only; B0 and Bnew contain BNPL repayments only.
Emergency savings coverage assumes no new income and unchanged expenses and repayments; it is not actual time until funds run out.
A positive monthly buffer does not guarantee enough cash on each payment due date.
These are deterministic scenario calculations, not empirical model results or BNPL default probabilities.
Proposed Bnew is excluded; all other submitted amounts are retained.
